newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials rise, Nasdaq sees modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials rise, Nasdaq sees modest gains.

text.p: Blue chip stocks jumped higher on Friday after the May Producer Price Index came in below expectations.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 51 points to 7762 in late-morning activity. Advancers led decliners two to one.
The Nasdaq composite saw modest gains, rising almost four points to 1415.
PPI fell 0.3 percent, further easing fears that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates at its July meeting.
